summary: Backend regression tests for the event-dedupe fix on /api/track/registration. Wrote 5 pytest cases hitting the real backend (via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) with real MongoDB persistence. All 5 tests pass. The fix correctly dedupes 'cadastro' and 'inscricao' events using result.upserted_id, and preserves form_data via dot notation.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is now >1720 lines. Continues to violate the <700 LOC guideline. Split into tracking/dedupe/telegram/pix modules.

The dedupe key for 'cadastro' event is now 'first insert of the CPF' — meaning if the user's cadastro is deleted and they re-enter, a new event fires (expected behavior). Confirm this matches the product intent.

notify_or_update_telegram is called for EVERY finalized POST (even when new_inscricao is False). That's correct (edits existing message) but if the mensagem was never sent originally (Telegram unreachable), each retry will send a NEW message, and only after the first success will edits kick in. Consider caching 'telegram_send_failed' to backoff.
The registrations collection is still an append-only log (no dedupe there). That is intentional per code, but note db.registrations grows unbounded — add TTL or periodic cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Uses test CPFs 11122233344, 22233344455, 33344455566. All cleaned in autouse fixture before each test and at module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dedupe fix VERIFIED. Cadastro fires exactly 1 event per CPF (first upsert only). Inscricao fires exactly 1 event per (CPF, cargo_codigo) pair, with inscricoes_count incrementing only on new upserts. Two different cargos for same CPF -> 2 events (correct). Regression flow (registrations append log, cadastros upsert, inscricoes upsert, Telegram notify call) all still working. Iteration_1's OPEN issue (Telegram creds not in DB) remains outside this iteration's scope.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /inscricao.html and /dados-inscricao.html both POST /api/track/registration with stage=cadastro, and each call unconditionally called insert_event('cadastro'), producing duplicates in the admin feed. Fix in admin_routes.py:309, 362, 369, 375: use `result.upserted_id is not None` to detect whether the upsert was a true insert vs. update, and only emit the feed event on true inserts. Same technique applied to inscricao event and inscricoes_count increment. Verified with 5 tests covering: 5x cadastro→1 event, 2x finalized→1 event & count=1, 2 different cargos→2 events, admin realtime feed cleanliness, and regression of the normal flow.
